reports.text: Smt. Kavita Sharma filed a complaint stating that her husband Deepak Sharma has been missing since 2026-08-02. Deepak was last seen with his associate Rajesh Pillai at a warehouse in Bhiwandi. Call detail records show Rajesh contacted a number registered to Farhan Sheikh 14 times between 2026-07-28 and 2026-08-01. Farhan Sheikh transferred Rs. 4,50,000 to an account held by Sunita Rane on 2026-08-01, one day before Deepak went missing. The vehicle KA-05-MX-7788, registered to Rajesh Pillai, was flagged by an ANPR camera near the Bhiwandi warehouse on 2026-08-02 at 23:14. A second vehicle, MH-04-GT-2210 (unregistered owner), was seen at the same location minutes earlier. Sunita Rane's social media account shows check-ins at a resort in Lonavala with Farhan Sheikh dated 2026-08-03, the day after the transfer.
An unknown suspect called the victim from +91-9876543210. The number was registered at Nashik.
